# Durable Skyrim production fixtures

These small, immutable fixtures support tests that exercise the real Bethesda
readers/writers. They must not live under disposable `03-builds/work`.

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `P04SSE.esp` | `040F0282F4020FA7EF8BC648F9D1BA7957EBA6484A9ACDC5E27A3A1F67231E87` |
| `FaceEditFixtureSSE.esp` | `F3C7B3AC9391515953A1F860AC65CA5663BD3DB6A1F23AAE16903D28749DA86A` |
| `SelectivePasteFixtureSSE.esp` | `3125CB1B23BFF48A3B771F936F66B0CC2897F612E3CFFBD3A97B7E63356D8B3D` |
| `synthetic-dxt5-facetint.dds` | `70592CDC13D11A910EC7EAC90743B6D0774A3E9959FB19730961B44FD76A18D9` |
| `Gate23FaceTint.dds` | `621B26C0880D592B22AB12E7BB4AE2FC7A9689203B9C33191A98BD13F7C3B7EC` |

The three plugins are deterministic outputs of
`tools/fixtures/m2/fixture-generator.csproj`:

- `--headparts` produces `P04SSE.esp` and the ten small `meshes/p04` files;
- `--sky-gui-011-012-face-edit` produces `FaceEditFixtureSSE.esp`;
- `--sky-gui-014-selective-paste` produces
  `SelectivePasteFixtureSSE.esp`.

`synthetic-dxt5-facetint.dds` is a product-owned constant-color BC3/DXT5
test fixture with a 512x512 top level and complete mip chain. Every block uses
the same fixed alpha and RGB565 endpoints. The Gate 1 check uses it to verify
byte-exact packaging and decoder evidence, not image appearance.

The Gate 23 production-package test uses the product-owned synthetic
no-packed-normal NIF at
`../sse-packed-normals/dynamic-16-no-normals.nif`. Its adjacent manifest and
`generate.py` describe and reproduce the synthetic geometry. It is a test
carrier, not a Skyrim-derived head or a product asset. The package test copies
it with `Gate23FaceTint.dds` into a fresh package. The tint DDS is generated by
the tracked `tools/fixtures/m9/p11-facegen-tint-bound.ps1` script.

`SelectivePasteFixtureSSE.esp` is paired with the canonical source and target
JSlots under `tools/fixtures/sky-gui-014`; those text fixtures are not
duplicated here.
